blocks.x: Cyber & Zero-Trust for Electronics & Semiconductors — zero-trust by architecture, not by slide — identity, detection, resilience and ai security in one program applied to the electronics & semiconductors operating unit of Manufacturing & Industrial.

Semis and electronics fabrication run the tightest quality-latency loops in industry: yield analytics, tool matching and cleanroom reliability decided by telemetry at nanometer stakes. The fabs that win industrialize root-cause analytics and predictive tool health end to end.

items: Process recipes are state-grade targets; OT security maturity uneven.
Process telemetry, metrology and defect data siloed; excursion root-cause takes days of fab time.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Compliance, Audit & Digital Trust, Threat Intelligence & Managed SOC, Zero-Trust Architecture & Implementation from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Yield analytics/excursion RCA, Defect classification, Predictive tool maintenance) on Tele Medicine Platform and Driisti Smart Vision Glasses. Governance inherits the sector frame — Export controls among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Secure the models themselves — prompt-injection defense, agent containment and AI red-teaming.
Assume breach, plan recovery — resilience engineered, rehearsed and measured.
Evidence once, audit anywhere — compliance automation across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, DORA and privacy.
